Load data

```{r}
#load package
library(tidyverse)   #data manipulation, visualization etc. (dplyr, ggplot2, tidyr)

#read in data
bee <- read.csv("06_cleandata/bee_clean.csv")
floral <- read.csv("06_cleandata/floral_clean.csv")
rodent <- read.csv("06_cleandata/rodent_clean.csv")
site_info <- read.csv("06_cleandata/site_info_clean.csv")
```

Add area names to datasets

```{r}
bee <- bee %>%
  left_join(site_info %>% select(site_id, area, cover_type), by = c("site_id"))

floral <- floral %>%
  left_join(site_info %>% select(site_id, area, cover_type), by = c("site_id"))

rodent <- rodent %>%
  left_join(site_info %>% select(site_id, area, cover_type), by = c("site_id"))
```

Filter to only include within field plots

```{r}
#filter to only include field data
bee <- bee %>%
  filter(plot_id != "d")

floral <- floral %>%
  filter(plot_id != "d")

rodent <- rodent %>%
  filter(plot_id != "d")
```

Create bee summary table

```{r}
bee_summary <- bee %>%
  # treat empty strings as NA
  mutate(
    caste = na_if(caste, ""),
    bee_species = na_if(bee_species, "")
  ) %>%
  group_by(bee_species) %>%
  summarise(
    `Total individuals (count)` = n(),
    `Queens (count)` = sum(caste == "q", na.rm = TRUE),
    `Workers (count)` = sum(caste == "w", na.rm = TRUE),
    `Males (count)` = sum(caste == "m", na.rm = TRUE),
    `Unknown caste (count)` = sum(is.na(caste)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Relative frequency` = 
      `Total individuals (count)` / sum(`Total individuals (count)`)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Total individuals (count)`))  %>%
  mutate(
    bee_species = replace_na(bee_species, "unknown")
  )
```

Create site-level summary table for bumble bees, rodent burrows, and flowers

```{r}
#bee
site_level_summary_bee <- bee %>%
  mutate(
    cover_type = factor(cover_type, levels = c("grass", "bare")), 
    bee_species = na_if(bee_species, "")
  ) %>%
  group_by(area, site_id, cover_type) %>%
  summarise(
    `Bombus individuals (count)` = n(),
    `Bee species richness` = n_distinct(bee_species, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(area, cover_type)

#rodent
site_level_summary_rodent <- rodent %>%
  mutate(
    cover_type = factor(cover_type, levels = c("grass", "bare"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(area, site_id, cover_type) %>%
  summarise(
    `Rodent burrows (count)` = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(area, cover_type)

#floral
site_level_summary_floral <- floral %>%
  mutate(
    cover_type = factor(cover_type, levels = c("grass", "bare"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(area, site_id, cover_type) %>%
  summarise(
    `Average floral abundance (log-scale)` = mean(abundance),
    `Floral species richness` = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(area, cover_type)
```

Combine into one site-level summary table

```{r}
site_level_summary <- site_level_summary_bee %>%
  left_join(
    site_level_summary_rodent %>%
      select(area, site_id, cover_type, `Rodent burrows (count)`),
    by = c("area", "site_id", "cover_type")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    site_level_summary_floral %>%
      select(area, site_id, cover_type, `Average floral abundance (log-scale)`, `Floral species richness`),
    by = c("area", "site_id", "cover_type")
  )

    
```
